concepts.name: industrial
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: first-person grenade launcher redesign reference for the existing browser FPS VOXEL BLITZ. Input image: current in-game screenshot, preserve the framing and target-room background as a style reference. Primary request: aggressively redesign the boring olive GL-3 SKIPJACK into an expressive arcade bank-shot launcher with a powerful unique silhouette, while it still reads as a compact three-shot grenade launcher with one enclosed chamber and two externally visible spare shells. Keep gun occupying lower right, central aim area clear, tangible low-poly/PBR game style, compact optic, practical visible grip/support hand. This is a concept reference to implement in Three.js, not a photograph. Show one coherent polished in-game first-person concept with a smaller inset side profile for shape guidance. Avoid cluttered HUD, spurious numbers, oversized center-blocking parts or unrelated scene changes. Direction A: Industrial breacher. Gunmetal chassis with bold amber-orange armored panels, exposed circular chamber ring and three-cell flank cassette, massive vented muzzle cage, pistons and mechanical charging rails, visibly thicker handguard, glowing amber shell tips and short warm tracer. Shape is squat, robust, forward-heavy, aggressive industrial construction with clean readable hard-surface shapes. No unnecessary spikes.
